snippet.title: Pass the Blunt | Announcement Trailer | Party Card Game for 2-6 Players
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4962440/Pass_the_Blunt/

One blunt. A deck full of Bad Trips. Friends you can't trust. Pass the Blunt is a party card game for 2 to 6 players where holding the blunt makes your cards hit harder and your problems twice as big. Last one standing wins.

Coming soon to Steam!

🃏 2 to 6 players. 10 to 20 minutes a round. "One more" every time.
🌐 Casual and ranked online queues, plus a seasonal leaderboard.
🔒 Private sesh with a room code, just for your circle.
🤖 Nobody online? The bots are always down.
💻 Windows, macOS and Linux at the same table.

Website: https://passtheblunt.me
X: https://x.com/passbluntgame

No actual blunts included. Pass the Blunt is a fictional party game for adults.

#PassTheBlunt #IndieGame #PartyGame #CardGame
